subject: bar-tailed godwit
title: A 4-Month-Old Bird Flew 8,425 Miles Without Stopping

scenes.text: A four-month-old bird flew eleven days without stopping once.
A young bar-tailed godwit left Alaska on October 13th, 2022, and landed in Tasmania eleven days later.
That is 8,425 miles nonstop, a record, about 765 miles every single day.
Godwits fatten up until their weight more than doubles. Their intestines and gizzard shrink to leave room for fat.
Researchers describe it as no food, no water, and no sleep as we know it.
Eleven days. Zero stops. And it was a teenager.

description:
A juvenile bar-tailed godwit flew from Alaska to Tasmania, 8,425 miles in about eleven days, with no stops.
Godwits fatten until their body weight more than doubles before the journey, and their digestive organs shrink to make room for fat.
Researchers call it no food, no water, and no sleep as we know it.
What is the longest trip you have ever taken? Comment below.
first_comment: An earlier godwit made it from Alaska to New Zealand in eight days. Which animal journey is the most impossible to you?
